title: Apartamento T2, Centro da Benedita
description:

- Excellent flat located in the heart of Vila da Benedita, with great sun exposure and plenty of natural light. Ideal for those seeking comfort, modern finishes, and the convenience of daily life on foot.

- Property Layout:

. Room
